notes: Messenger (MAIL) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5 ERC-20 at src/Messenger.sol with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 MAIL (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, INITIAL_SUPPLY) once to msg.sender, the factory. There is no owner, mint, burn, pause, blacklist, transfer tax, reflection, rebase, upgrade or seizure mechanism; every transfer delivers exactly the requested amount, so the swarm's share, the pool seed, claims and swaps all move exactly what they say. No application contracts are deployed with it and no initialization calls are needed. The pool pairs MAIL with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 on Robinhood Chain; initialPrice is provenance only and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
